title: Why you think AI can only replace other people’s job! 🤖
transcript: Why you think AI can only replace other people’s job! 🤖

top_comments.author: @TheChris2hill
top_comments.text: I work at a register and I am fully aware AI can take my job however one person said they go to the location I work not for the prices but the experience. Building that kind of relationship with customers can’t be done with ai. (Also it’s a pet store so feeding may become a challenge.)
